method: cuts: union of ffmpeg scene>0.25 and >0.35 (merged within 3 frames; cut_in_strong = in 0.35 set); lap = Laplacian variance at 1080p; logos: temporal median Sobel edge mask over 76-80 frames per source found no persistent corner/edge marks, so no removelogo; subtitles: none seen on the shot sheets (text_score heuristic only fires on the white sketch-line shots mks1 #121-122).
